sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: One of the twin beings born from the spirit of the great deity who created life, Rapelle inherited that deity's original optimism and generosity. When she saw corruption steadily consuming her maker, she descended from the heavens to roam Seltavia. She tried every remedy she could-holy flame, cleansing wind-in hopes of purging even a fragment of the decay. None of them worked; the corruption only grew stronger. At last, Rapelle turned her efforts from restoring the deity directly to uncovering the very source of the corruption itself.

When she saw corruption steadily consuming her maker, she descended from the heavens to roam Seltavia. She tried every remedy she could-holy flame, cleansing wind-in hopes of purging even a fragment of the decay. None of them worked; the corruption only grew stronger.
